nodes.label: IndexCache: Cross-Layer Index Reuse for Sparse Attention
nodes.rationale: IndexCache exploits cross-layer redundancy in sparse attention indexers to reduce computational cost by reusing top-k indices across layers, eliminating up to 75% of indexer cost without performance degradation.

nodes.label: Dynamic Sparse Attention (DSA)
nodes.rationale: DSA is a sparse attention method with dynamic token selection that IndexCache builds upon; it uses a lightweight indexer to select top-k tokens rather than relying on fixed sparse patterns.

nodes.label: TidalDecode
nodes.rationale: Cross-layer sparse decoding method that reuses top-k indices from periodic anchor layers; represents prior work in cross-layer sharing that IndexCache extends.

nodes.label: LessIsMore
nodes.rationale: Training-free sparse attention method with global locality that reuses top-k indices from anchor layers for efficient reasoning.

nodes.label: OmniKV
nodes.rationale: Dynamic context selection method for efficient long-context LLMs that shares KV caches across layers.

nodes.label: DELTA
nodes.rationale: Dynamic layer-aware token attention method for efficient long-context reasoning that reuses top-k indices from anchor layers.

nodes.label: Kascade
nodes.rationale: Formalizes anchor layer selection via dynamic programming over cross-layer similarity matrix; identifies head-aware remapping as critical for maintaining accuracy in sparse attention.

nodes.label: HySparse
nodes.rationale: Hybrid sparse attention architecture that unifies sparse decoding and KV cache sharing by interleaving full attention layers with sparse layers inheriting both top-k indices and KV caches.

nodes.label: MoBA (Mixture of Block Attention)
nodes.rationale: Block-level sparse attention method that could benefit from cross-layer index reuse principle similar to IndexCache.

nodes.label: NSA (Native Sparse Attention)
nodes.rationale: Hardware-aligned and natively trainable sparse attention method that could benefit from cross-layer index reuse.

nodes.label: IndexCache: Accelerating Sparse Attention via Cross-Layer Index Reuse
nodes.author: Yushi Bai, Qian Dong, Ting Jiang, Xin Lv, Zhengxiao Du, Aohan Zeng, Jie Tang, Juanzi Li
nodes.rationale: Exploits cross-layer redundancy in sparse attention indexing. Demonstrates that token selection is highly correlated across layers, enabling 75% reduction in indexer computations with negligible quality loss.

nodes.label: Cross-Layer Index Reuse in Sparse Attention
nodes.rationale: Exploits empirical finding that token selection is highly correlated across consecutive transformer layers (70-100% overlap). Enables dramatic reduction in indexer computations by reusing indices from subset of layers.

nodes.label: Multi-Layer Distillation Loss
nodes.rationale: Training objective that distills each retained indexer against averaged attention distributions of all layers it serves. Mathematically equivalent to distilling against centroid of target distributions.

nodes.label: Greedy Layer Selection Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Training-free method for determining which layers retain indexers. Iteratively converts Full layers to Shared layers, selecting conversions that minimize LM loss on calibration set.

nodes.label: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA)
nodes.rationale: Production-grade sparse attention mechanism using lightweight lightning indexer to select top-k tokens. Reduces core attention from O(L²) to O(Lk) but indexer retains O(L²) complexity at each layer.

nodes.label: Indexer Redundancy Across Layers
nodes.rationale: Empirical observation: adjacent DSA layers share 70-100% of selected tokens. Heatmap analysis reveals distinct layer clusters with high mutual overlap, indicating most indexer computations are redundant.

nodes.label: Training-Free IndexCache
nodes.rationale: Applies to off-the-shelf DSA models without weight updates. Greedy search determines optimal layer pattern by minimizing LM loss on calibration set.

nodes.label: Training-Aware IndexCache
nodes.rationale: Optimizes model parameters for cross-layer sharing via multi-layer distillation loss. Enables simple uniform patterns to match full-indexer accuracy through joint adaptation.

nodes.label: Layer Importance Ordering
nodes.rationale: Greedy search reveals natural ordering of indexer importance: early layers are 'easy' to remove, while later layers are 'critical'. Suggests intrinsic model property rather than data artifact.

nodes.label: Indexer Time Proportion Analysis
nodes.rationale: Profiling shows indexer share of total latency rises sharply with context length (27% at 10K, 81% at 200K prefill). Identifies indexer cost reduction as key to accelerating long-context DSA.

nodes.label: Full/Shared Layer Partitioning
nodes.rationale: IndexCache partitions layers into Full (retain indexers) and Shared (reuse indices). Adds single conditional branch in inference with no additional GPU memory overhead.

nodes.label: Index Overlap Heatmap Analysis
nodes.rationale: Pairwise top-k index overlap across layers reveals distinct clusters with high mutual overlap. Visualizes redundancy structure enabling cross-layer index reuse.

nodes.label: GLM-5 Scaling Results
nodes.rationale: Preliminary results on 744B GLM-5 model confirm IndexCache scalability. Achieves 1.2-1.3x speedup with negligible degradation, demonstrating applicability to production-scale models.
